tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }

		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }

		}
	}

tv_wonder_great_port_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6503 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6003 }
		}
	}
}

		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:tv_wonder_finalization_outcome ?= 2 } } var:tv_wonder_site ?= { remove_location_modifier = tv_wonder_great_port_ritual_2_location_modifier } }

		}

	tv_wonder_great_port_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { OR = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 1 var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } } tv_wonder_great_port_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes }
	tv_wonder_register_current_project_priority_candidate_from_variables_effect = yes
	var:tv_wonder_site ?= { tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes }
if = {

}
else = {
set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id|3)" }
if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < var:tv_wonder_level }
remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = 3 }
add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = 3 value = var:tv_wonder_level }
}
remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
}
	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_finalization_outcome ?= 0 }
set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
if = {
limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 3 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 3 value = var:tv_wonder_level }
}
else = {
set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|3)" }
if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < var:tv_wonder_level }
remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 3 }

			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner

			if = {

tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6509 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6009 }
		}
	}
}

}

	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_finalization_outcome ?= 0 }

if = {

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6511 }
		}

		}
	}
}

remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 12 }

}
else = {

if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < var:tv_wonder_level }

	}

	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 13
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value >= 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6513 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6013 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 15
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_bastion_trial_fortress }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_bastion_trial_fortress cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }

				if = {

					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bastion_trial_fortress value = 3 owner = prev }

				}
			}
			else_if = {

				if = {

					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_bastion_trial_fortress value = 4 owner = prev }
				}

tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6515 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6015 }
		}
	}
}

}
remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
}
	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_finalization_outcome ?= 0 }

if = {

tv_wonder_giant_armory_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 17
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}

tv_wonder_giant_armory_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6517 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6017 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_large_canal_system_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6519 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6019 }
		}
	}
}

	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6526 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6026 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_colonial_trade_company_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6548 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6048 }
		}
	}
}

			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_wagon_camp_muster }

tv_wonder_mobile_fortress_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6550 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6050 }
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6607 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6107 }
		}
	}
}

		}

tv_wonder_unique_great_zimbabwe_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6624 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6124 }
		}
	}
}

	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_news_level value = var:tv_wonder_level }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6640 }
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6140 }
		}
	}
}

	}

		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }

		}

		}
	}

		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }

		}
	}

		}
	}

	}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		if = { limit = { scope:tv_wonder_builder_country = { var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6704 }
		}

		}
	}
